message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have the calendars for Priya and Marcus. Now I will find the common free time blocks. I need to be careful and methodical.

**Monday:**
Priya free: 9:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
Marcus free: 9:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
Common free time: 9:00-10:00 (1 hour)

**Tuesday:**
Priya free: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
Marcus free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
Common free time: 13:00-14:00 (1 hour), 16:30-17:00 (30 minutes)

**Wednesday:**
Priya free: 9:00-9:30 (Priya is busy at 9:00), 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
Marcus free: 9:00-9:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00,
Common free time: 9:00-9:30 is not free for Priya. 15:00-16:00 (1 hour)

**Thursday:**
Priya free: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30
Marcus free: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
Common free time: 10:00-10:30 (30 minutes)

**Friday:**
Priya free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30
Marcus free: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00
Common free time: 11:00-12:00 (1 hour)

So, the common free blocks are:
*   Monday: 9:00-10:00
*   Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
*   Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
*   Thursday: 10:00-10:30
*   Friday: 11:00-12:00

I will post this to the workspace for Brad. This is much more helpful than individual slots.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully identified the blocks of time where both Priya Raman and Marcus Hale are available. This is a much better approach than sending individual 30-minute slots, as it gives Brad more flexibility when checking against the calendars of the other two partners. My next and final action for this session is to communicate this information clearly to Brad through the shared workspace. I'll then end my session, awaiting his response.

Alison"}
